proof_boundary: Independent merge and graph derivations, existing public fuel and static constructor-name sequence; compiler comparisons are external tests, not proofs of parsing or constructor-body execution.

typed_interfaces.Solidity.Frontend.C3Exactness.merge_iff: ∀ {n : Nat} {ls : List (List String)} {out : List String}, Env.merge n ls = some out ↔ Trace ls out ∧ out.length < n
typed_interfaces.Solidity.Frontend.C3Exactness.Trace.uniq: ∀ {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] {ls : List (List α)} {a b : List α}, Trace ls a → Trace ls b → a = b
typed_interfaces.Solidity.Frontend.C3Exactness.linearize_: ∀ {E : Env}, E.basesOK = true → ∀ (c : String) (L : List String), E.linearize c = some L ↔ ExactLin E c L
∀ {E : Env}, E.basesOK = true → ∀ c : String, E.linearize c = none ↔ GraphBlocked E c
∀ {E : Env} {c : String}, CyclePath E c c → ∀ n : Nat, E.linearizeF n c = none
typed_interfaces.Solidity.Frontend.C3Exactness.IdentityLi: ∀ {E : Env} {i : Nat} {a b : List Nat}, IdentityLin E i a → IdentityLin E i b → E.basesOK = true → a = b
typed_interfaces.Solidity.Frontend.C3Exactness.unit_ident: ∀ (u : Syn .unit), u.env.basesOK = true → ∀ c : String, c ∈ u.env.contractNames → ∀ I : List Nat, (u.env.linearize c).map (List.map (rank u.env)) = some I ↔ IdentityLin u.env (rank u.env c) I
typed_interfaces.Solidity.Frontend.C3Exactness.resolved_i: ∀ {s : Settings} {u : Syn .unit} {r : Resolution}, Resolves' s u r → r.env.basesOK = true → ∀ c : String, c ∈ r.env.contractNames → ∀ I : List Nat, (r.env.linearize c).map (List.map (rank r.env)) = some I ↔ IdentityLin r.env (rank r.env c) I
typed_interfaces.Solidity.Frontend.C3Exactness.ctor_monot: ∀ {E : Env} {c b : String} {L Lb : List String}, E.linearize c = some L → b ∈ E.bases c → E.linearize b = some Lb → (E.ctorOrder b).Sublist (E.ctorOrder c).dropLast
typed_interfaces.Solidity.Frontend.C3Exactness.ctor_nodup: ∀ {E : Env} {c : String} {L : List String}, E.basesOK = true → E.linearize c = some L → (E.ctorOrder c).Nodup
typed_interfaces.Solidity.Frontend.C3Exactness.Trace.comm: ∀ {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] {ls : List (List α)} {out : List α}, Trace ls out → CommonOrder ls out
typed_interfaces.Solidity.Frontend.C3Exactness.Obstructio: ∀ {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] {ls : List (List α)}, Obstruction ls → ∀ out, ¬ CommonOrder ls out
typed_interfaces.Solidity.Frontend.C3Exactness.Stuck.not_: ∀ {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] {ls : List (List α)}, Stuck ls → ∀ out, ¬ CommonOrder ls out
typed_interfaces.Solidity.Frontend.C3Exactness.stuck_iff_: ∀ {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (ls : List (List α)), Stuck ls ↔ ¬ ∃ out, CommonOrder ls out
typed_interfaces.Solidity.Frontend.C3Exactness.trace_exis: ∀ {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (ls : List (List α)), (∃ out, Trace ls out) ↔ ∃ out, CommonOrder ls out
typed_interfaces.Solidity.Frontend.C3Exactness.merge_boun: ∀ ls : List (List String), Env.merge (fuelBound ls) ls = none ↔ ¬ ∃ out, CommonOrder ls out
∀ ls : List (List String), (∃ out, Env.merge (fuelBound ls) ls = some out) ↔ ∃ out, CommonOrder ls out
typed_interfaces.Solidity.Frontend.C3Exactness.merge_none: ∀ (n : Nat) (ls : List (List String)), Env.merge n ls = none ↔ (¬ ∃ out, CommonOrder ls out) ∨ ∃ out, Trace ls out ∧ n ≤ out.length
typed_interfaces.Solidity.Frontend.C3Exactness.Controls.c: ∀ {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (a b : α), ∀ out, ¬ CommonOrder [[a, b], [b, a]] out

syntax_proofs: #check (show graphSpecs ["A"] = Syn.cons (Syn.inherit ⟨"A", []⟩ Syn.none) Syn.nil from rfl)
#check (show graphUnit [("A", [])] = Syn.unit (Syn.cons (Syn.contract false "A" Syn.none Syn.nil Syn.nil) Syn.nil) from rfl)
#check (show graphInterfaceUnit [("I", [])] = Syn.unit (Syn.cons (Syn.interface "I" Syn.nil Syn.nil) Syn.nil) from rfl)
#check (show (fun {α : Type} (ls : List (List α)) (out : List α) => CommonOrder ls out) = (fun {α : Type} (ls : List (List α)) (out : List α) => out.Nodup ∧ ∀ l ∈ ls, l.Sublist out) from rfl)
